remarks: Newly completed by Compo Luxury Homes, this exceptional modern estate offers approximately 9,200 square feet on 2.1 private acres just minutes from downtown Westport, Compo Beach, and Metro-North. Thoughtfully designed with European craftsmanship, premium finishes, and sophisticated smart-home technology, the home blends timeless design with exceptional functionality.  A dramatic floating staircase anchors four finished levels featuring soaring ceilings, custom millwork, and engineered white oak flooring. The chef's kitchen showcases dual quartzite waterfall islands, custom rift white oak cabinetry, a walk-in pantry, and a professional appliance suite. The primary suite offers cathedral ceilings, a fireplace, private balcony, dual dressing rooms, and a spa-inspired bath with heated floors and a soaking tub.  Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, the nearly 950-square-foot covered terrace features granite flooring, a wood-burning fireplace, outdoor kitchen, heated 20' 40' saltwater pool, year-round spa, and room for a future tennis or pickleball court. The walk-out lower level includes a family room, wet bar, fitness studio, guest suite, and flexible space for a theater, golf simulator, or media lounge.  Additional highlights include a DaVinci slate roof, premium European windows and lift-and-slide doors, Lutron lighting, whole-home networking, seven-zone HVAC, security system, and a 32kW Generac generator.
